title: Missing erl makes the runner unavailable, which stops the Build

fixture_files..kogen/project.yaml:
name: hello
checks:
  - name: compile
    argv: [mix, compile, --warnings-as-errors]
    timeout_ms: 300000
domains:
  app: [lib]

notes: Elixir is hidden from the Build (after approval) by stubs in the case's stub dir, first on PATH, for `elixir` and `mix` that print a missing-`erl` error and exit 127 (the adapter's unavailable signal); Kogen itself keeps running. The project has no setup so that the base acceptance run is the first Elixir call.

reply.text:
Difficulty: easy

## Acceptance criteria
- A1: Hello.greet/0 returns Hello, Almir!

## Technical approach
Change the return value.

## Implementation steps
1. Edit lib/hello.ex.

steps.sh:
for t in elixir mix; do printf '#!/bin/sh
echo "/usr/bin/env: erl: No such file or directory"
exit 127
' > "{stubs}/$t"; chmod +x "{stubs}/$t"; done

stdout_lines: ~queue: stopped because greet hit an environment error; [0-9]+ Build\(s\), 0 landed, [0-9]+ not
